svg.data-weight-note: 23.5 lb (10.66 kg) fully loaded, QFX5200-32C and QFX5200-32C-L (Table 31)
svg.data-port-speeds: QSFP28 ports 0 to 31, 100 GbE by default; 50, 40, 25 or 10 GbE by configuration or with a breakout cable (up to 128 logical ports)
svg.data-power-input-ac: 100 to 240 VAC, 50 to 60 Hz, 4.5 A at 100 to 120 VAC or 2.0 A at 200 to 240 VAC
svg.data-power-input-dc: rated -48 to -60 VDC, operating range -40 to -72 VDC, 10 A maximum
svg.data-redundancy-note: two supplies, load-sharing; one may be removed at a time while the switch runs
svg.data-fans: five fan modules; the switch runs 30 seconds without thermal shutdown while one is replaced
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-humidity: 5 to 90 percent noncondensing (up to 93 percent short term)
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation to 2000 m (6562 ft)
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to three QFX5200-32C members (not the 32C-L)
svg.data-timing: RJ45 grand master clock jack (GM), 1 PPS output, 10 MHz output
svg.data-optics: 100 GbE QSFP28, 40 GbE QSFP+, AOC, DAC and breakout cables; a QSFP+ to SFP+ adapter (QSA) from Junos OS 19.3R1
svg.data-oob: SFP management cages C0 and C1 and an RJ45 C0 (10/100/1000 BASE-T); the 32C-L has no second management interface
svg.data-seismic: Designed to comply with Zone 4 earthquake requirements per NEBS GR-63-CORE, Issue 3 (Table 30 wording)
